reason_summary: The §73 spec proposed a new lifecycle_state_change schema. That duplicates the §37 Event Engine state-transition family. Refusing to mint a parallel event family for interop lifecycle state changes.
remediation_hint: REUSE the §37 kye.signal.state.transitioned.v1 canonical (Event Engine). Map lifecycle_state_change to it in the §73 profile manifest instead of minting a new schema.
